title: fix(fields): `signature` answers `{}` as its string value class does (objectui#8677)
body:
Fixes #8677
Clause-②: no

`signature` is a `STRING_VALUE_TYPES` member in `@objectstack/spec` ("Value is a plain string"; the stored value is a data-URI PNG), but `getCellRenderer` mapped it straight to `ImageCellRenderer`. That renderer answers "nothing to draw" with the media rule ("No value"), so a `signature` cell holding `{}` drew the shared affordance where every other member of its value class prints `[Object]`, the answer objectui#8580 ruled for the class and objectui#8596 applied to the rest of it. This PR brings the straggler into line and decides nothing new.

## The change

- `getCellRenderer('signature')` now resolves to a new, unexported `SignatureCellRenderer` with two arms:
  - a value the image cell can draw (the stored data-URI string, and the URL / file-reference shapes `ImageCellRenderer` already resolved) goes to `ImageCellRenderer`, unchanged;
  - anything else goes to `TextCellRenderer`, the class's reference renderer: `[]`, `''` and `null` still reach the affordance (same bytes as before), and `{}` prints `[Object]`.
- Both renderers ask one shared predicate, `displayableImagesOf`, extracted from `ImageCellRenderer`'s own memo body with no change to what it computes. So the signature cell can never send a value to the image arm that the image arm then drops, which would bring back the "No value" this PR removes.
- `image` / `avatar` still resolve to `ImageCellRenderer` itself. Their output is byte-identical (measured below). They are `FILE_REFERENCE_TYPES`, and "No value" is their correct answer to `{}`.
- No export added or removed. Changeset: `patch` on `@object-ui/fields`, following objectui#8596's own changeset. AGENTS.md reserves `minor` for breaking changes.

## Census, measured through `getCellRenderer` (before = `71a4a5335`, after = this branch)

Population: every `STRING_VALUE_TYPES` member read from the installed spec (all fourteen have a cell renderer), plus `image` and `avatar` as controls. Each was rendered against `[]`, `{}`, `''`, `null`, a data-URI string, `{ url }`, `{ id, name }`, `{ foo: 1 }`, `{ name }`, `0` and `[{}]`. That is 176 cells, diffed on `innerHTML`. **5 cells moved, all in the `signature` row**, and each one now equals what `text` draws for the same input:

| `signature` holding | before | after (= `text`) |
|---|---|---|
| `{}` | shared affordance ("No value") | `[Object]` |
| `{ foo: 1 }` | shared affordance | `[Object]` |
| `{ name: 'Ada' }` | shared affordance | `Ada` |
| `0` | shared affordance | `0` |
| `[{}]` | shared affordance | `[Object]` |

Unchanged (byte-identical before and after): `signature` for `[]`, `''`, `null`, the data-URI string, `{ url }` and `{ id, name }`; every sibling in every column; `image` and `avatar` in every column.

The class's empty-shaped columns on this base, re-taken from the live renderers rather than copied from the card:
- `text` / `textarea` / `code` / `qrcode` / `email` / `url` / `phone` / `color` print `{}` as the truncating SPAN reading `[Object]`, and draw the affordance for `[]` / `''` / `null`.
- `markdown` / `html` / `richtext` print the same text `[Object]` inside their prose container, with the same affordance for the other three.
- `password` / `secret` draw a value-independent mask for everything.

Only the last four rows of that table go beyond the card's four inputs. They are off-spec non-string values that no image can be drawn from, and they now read exactly as `text` reads them, which is the class's answer. That is the reading the ruling's reason gives ("the record IS storing something, so No value is false").

## Deviation from the dispatch's mechanism assumption (Zone 2, item 2), measured

The assumption said to route "non-string values the way the class does". Measured, that would stop drawing populated signatures that are not bare strings, and three pins say those must keep their image:
- objectui#8596's `POPULATED` census renders `signature` holding `{ url }`;
- `summaryChip.badgeFitCensus-8464` in `plugin-detail` renders `signature` holding `{ id, name }` and records it as an image with no text;
- the card's own scope note says a populated `{ url: ... }` signature "renders its thumbnail, unchanged and unaffected".

So the arm split is "can the image cell draw it", not "is it a string". Every string draws except `''`, so for spec-shaped values the two readings agree.

## Pins

New: `packages/fields/src/__tests__/cellRenderers.signatureValueClass-8677.test.tsx`
- **THE PREMISE**: `STRING_VALUE_TYPES` / `FILE_REFERENCE_TYPES` are imported from the installed `@objectstack/spec/data`, never hand-copied. `signature` is in the string class and not the media class; `image` / `avatar` the reverse.
- **THE CENSUS**, per input `[]` / `{}` / `''` / `null`:
  - `signature` renders byte-equal to `text`, with the control asserted real first;
  - its face (text plus affordance presence) equals every value-bearing class member read from the spec.
  - The masked-credential members are excluded by name, and a separate test proves each one really is value-independent, so the exclusion cannot go stale.
- **THE DEFECT**: `{}` draws no affordance and no image, and prints `[Object]`.
- **POPULATED** (lit rows): the data-URI string, `{ url }`, `{ id, name }` and a two-image array each still draw their IMG, byte-equal to what `image` draws for the same value.
- **THE CONTROLS**:
  - `getCellRenderer('image')` and `getCellRenderer('avatar')` are still `ImageCellRenderer`;
  - both still answer all four empty-shaped inputs with the affordance, and still draw a populated value;
  - `signature` and `image` part ways on `{}` and only on `{}`.

Moved: objectui#8596's census row for `signature` goes from the affordance to `[Object]`. That row pinned the defect itself, so any repair must move it. It now sits in its own group with a pointer to the new pin. Its `POPULATED` row (`{ url }`) is unchanged and still green.

## Ablations: committed first, mutated on disk, restored by blob

Both used `ablation-replace.mjs` from `../objectstack`: anchor hit asserted, a trap armed, restore proven. Each time the blob after restore equalled the HEAD blob `4422764c234d` and `git diff HEAD` was empty.

1. **Route `signature` back to `ImageCellRenderer`** (the registration before this change). The anchor `signature: SignatureCellRenderer,` went x1 to x0, the replacement x0 to x1, and the blob moved from `4422764c234d` to `c95f5a5f51ca`. Result: **6 red, 51 green** across the new pin plus objectui#8596's file.
   - Red: the `{}` byte-equal row ("expected the affordance SPAN to be the `[Object]` SPAN"), the `{}` sibling row (it listed all eleven value-bearing siblings as disagreeing), THE DEFECT, the non-drawable-object case, THE BOUNDARY, and objectui#8596's census ("signature holding {}: the measured face moved: expected '—' to be '[Object]'").
   - Green, as expected: the `[]` / `''` / `null` rows (both renderers draw the same affordance), every POPULATED row, and every `image` / `avatar` control.
2. **The caricature, `signature` always as `TextCellRenderer`**. The blob moved from `4422764c234d` to `90a2bd69c753`. Result: **4 red, 19 green**. All four POPULATED rows went red ("still draws an image: expected null not to be null"; the two-image row received the joined URLs as text). This is why the POPULATED rows are the load-bearing ones.

## Verification: all at `58caf4439` (HEAD) unless noted

- `pnpm exec vitest run packages/fields/` plus every suite outside `packages/fields` that calls `getCellRenderer` / `listCellRendererTypes`, or that names `signature` in `plugin-detail` / `plugin-grid`: **214 files passed, 1 skipped; 3442 tests passed, 7 skipped**. The other packages covered are `plugin-dashboard`, `plugin-detail`, `plugin-grid`, `plugin-kanban`, `plugin-list` and `plugin-report`.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/fields type-check`, after building its dependency closure (`--filter '@object-ui/fields^...' build`): exit 0. `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --listFiles` lists both touched test files, so the test program does check them.
- ESLint on the three touched files, 0 errors each:
  - `index.tsx` per-rule counts are identical to base (93 `react-refresh/only-export-components`, 44 `no-explicit-any`, 1 `no-unused-vars`, all pre-existing warnings);
  - objectui#8596's test is identical to base (2 `no-explicit-any`);
  - the new pin has 0 warnings.
- `pnpm check:control-bytes` OK. `pnpm check:new-line-citations`: 0 new citations. `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs` passes, declaring `.changeset/8677-signature-cell-value-class.md`. `check-changeset-no-major` OK. `check:pending-changeset-literals` and `check:test-path-roots` OK.
- `pnpm check:changeset-claims` flagged four pending changesets that name `packages/fields/src/index.tsx`. I read all four paragraphs: this diff adds or removes none of the keys or reads they describe (a grep of the diff's changed lines for them returns zero). All four still hold.
- Not run locally: the repo-wide `pnpm lint` / full `pnpm test`, which are CI's. `plugin-designer`'s `MetadataFieldsPage.storedTypePreserved` lists `signature` as a designer field type, not a cell, and is left to CI.

## Acceptance notes

- **Not touched:** objectui#8580's ruling, every other class member, and `ImageCellRenderer`'s output.
- **Off-spec populated shape:** the `signature` populated row in objectui#8596's census holds `{ url }`, an object, while the spec types the value as a string. It is kept drawing on purpose (see the deviation above). Whether the renderer should keep tolerating it is a question for the spec side and is not opened here.
- **Docs:** no `content/docs` page or package README describes the `signature` cell, so there was nothing to update.
- **Found in the census, reported to the seat and not changed here:** a populated `signature` (and any `image` holding a `data:` URI) gets as its IMG `alt` the text after the URI's last slash, which is the whole base64 payload. `readFileValue` names a URL by its last path segment, and `ImageCellRenderer` prefers that name over its translated alt. On this base, the census's data-URI row reads `alt="png;base64,iVBORw0KGgo="` for `signature`, `image` and `avatar` alike. This PR leaves that byte-identical.
